name: greensun-hotel/values-grid
title: Values Grid
description: Three-up cards with oversized 01 / 02 / 03 numerals, title and body.

sectionTitle.default: A few principles, worn smooth by time.

default.title: Practical comfort
default.body: Nothing fussy. Just rooms that work, beds that recover you, and a desk where the wifi never wavers.

default.title: Quiet warmth
default.body: No theatrical greetings. Real ones. The kind you remember on a Tuesday in March.

default.title: Local first
default.body: Most of our team has been here years. The coffee comes from down the road. The art on the walls is by people we know.
